components.heading: Equipment.
components.text: The Chief of Police is hereby authorized to permit the use of the Police Department equipment and personnel by the capital area major case squad under the conditions set forth in this article. (Ord. 20206 § 11, 9-10-19. Code 1981 § 34-80. Code 1995 § 90-60. Formerly 2.120.080.)
